faqs.q: Can I increase my saving later?
faqs.a: Yes. You can top up within the plan's limits whenever you like. Exact limits are in your policy document.

faqs.q: Are the returns guaranteed?
faqs.a: No. Savings products carry no guaranteed returns. Your policy document explains how your fund is managed.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a payment?
faqs.a: There is a grace period. MLI Connect reminds you before the due date and lets you catch up in one tap.

faqs.q: Where can I buy it?
faqs.a: In MLI Connect, the only place to buy a Misr Life policy online. It verifies your identity with your phone camera, as the FRA requires.

about.body: Misr Life Insurance has protected Egyptian families for more than a century. Today we offer savings, protection and group cover through our own branches, licensed advisers and partner banks, and now through MLI Connect, the app that lets you buy and manage a policy from your phone.

company.title: About Misr Life
company.body: Egypt's life insurer since 1900, part of Misr Insurance Holding Company and supervised by the Financial Regulatory Authority.
who: Misr Life Insurance has protected Egyptian families since 1900. We offer savings, protection and group cover to individuals, companies and lenders across Egypt.
We are a subsidiary of Misr Insurance Holding Company, affiliated with The Sovereign Fund of Egypt, and we are licensed and supervised by the Financial Regulatory Authority under licence No. 3.
We sell through our branches, licensed advisers and partner banks, and now through MLI Connect, our app for buying and managing a policy from your phone.
company.bandCaption: Sailing boats on the Nile at Cairo, early twentieth century.
company.valuesBody: Four promises that shape every product, page and conversation.
values: We pay when it matters, without asking twice.
We speak plainly and never promise returns we cannot guarantee.
We treat your data as yours, under Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law.
We meet you where you are: a branch, an adviser, a partner bank or your phone.
next: Misr Life is renewing how it looks, sounds and serves. MLI Connect is the first piece: a younger, faster way to buy and manage a policy, with the same company behind it.
We are also preparing to list on the Egyptian Exchange, and our investor relations section is where shareholders and analysts will find everything they need.

how.body: Three steps, all on your phone. The identity check is the one the FRA requires for every digital sale, so it only happens once.

steps.name: Verify Your ID
steps.body: Scan the front and back of your national ID, then take a quick selfie.

steps.name: Choose Your Cover
steps.body: Pick a plan, slide the cover and see an indicative price as you go.

steps.name: Pay And Sign
steps.body: Pay by card or wallet and sign on screen. Your policy is issued straight away.

teasers.title: Start Small, Add More Later
teasers.body: Three plans to begin with. Indicative prices are inside the app, never on the website.

items.name: Simple Term Life
items.line: If something happens to you, your family gets a lump sum.

items.name: Maash Bokra
items.line: Save every month for the retirement you want, with life cover built in.

items.name: Family Protection Plan
items.line: Bigger cover for the people who depend on you, kids' education included.

teasers.note: Simple Term Life and the Family Protection Plan are placeholder products for this demo.

rhythm.title: There When It Counts
rhythm.body: MLI Connect will not ask for your attention every day. It shows up at the moments a policy actually needs you.

items.what: Pay your installment on payday in one tap, with a receipt and a reminder before it is due.
A quick check-in: married, new baby, new job? Your cover can keep up.
Your annual statement, renewal and a review of your beneficiaries.
Start a claim, upload documents and follow its status. Decisions are made by our claims team.

rhythm.caption: The Nile at dusk.

items.q: Why do I need to scan my face?
items.a: The Financial Regulatory Authority requires facial recognition for every life insurance policy sold digitally. It is also how we make sure nobody else can buy a policy in your name.

items.q: Can I buy on the website instead?
items.a: No. The website is for learning. Buying happens only in MLI Connect, where your identity can be verified.
It depends on your age, the cover and the term. The app shows an indicative premium as you choose, and the final price is confirmed after your application is reviewed.

items.q: Does the app hold my money?
items.a: No. You pay your premium to Misr Life. The goals you track in the app are for planning only.

items.q: I already have a policy. Can I use it?
items.a: Yes. You can track your policy and pay installments in the app.
Your data is encrypted and used only to verify your identity and run your policy, under Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law.

get.title: Get MLI Connect
get.body: Scan the code with your phone, or have the link sent to you.
get.formBody: On WhatsApp or by SMS, from our official number only.

same.title: The Same Misr Life, Since 1900
same.body: MLI Connect is the new, faster face of the company that has protected Egyptian families in Cairo and across Egypt for more than a century. Same licence, same promise, now in your pocket.
